name: Starbreeze Village
summary: Gnarlpine furbolgs have overrun Starbreeze Village, east of Dolanaar in Teldrassil. The once quiet night elf hamlet lies in ruins beneath the corruption spreading through the World Tree.

sections.title: A Fallen Hamlet
sections.body: Southeast of Shadowglen, just down the road from Dolanaar, Starbreeze Village lies in shambles. Night elf families once lived peacefully beneath Teldrassil’s boughs. Now aggressive Gnarlpine furbolgs occupy the wooden homes. Corruption afflicting the World Tree’s boughs has driven them wild. They drove out the elven residents and fiercely defend the ruined grounds.

sections.title: The Threat of Ferocitas
sections.body: Ferocitas the Dream Eater lurks on the settlement’s outskirts. The Gnarlpine presence there is more than an ordinary territorial raid. This enigmatic, corrupted entity points to foul magic driving the furbolgs mad. Hulking beasts like Uruson prowl the paths alongside them, making Starbreeze an active danger to travelers crossing eastern Teldrassil.

faq.answer: Gnarlpine furbolgs overran the village after falling prey to corruption spreading within Teldrassil. Driven mad and violent, they attacked the night elf inhabitants and forced them from their homes.

faq.q: Who lives in Starbreeze Village now?
faq.answer: Hostile Gnarlpine furbolgs occupy the village now. Among them are the wandering patrol Uruson and Ferocitas the Dream Eater, a corrupted figure.
Starbreeze Village lies in eastern Teldrassil, southeast of Shadowglen and east of Dolanaar.

faq.q: Who is Ferocitas the Dream Eater?
faq.answer: Ferocitas the Dream Eater is a dangerous, corrupted creature on the outskirts of Starbreeze Village. The creature is associated with the dark forces driving the local Gnarlpine tribe into a frenzy.

angles.text: As a night elf, seeing a settlement so close to Dolanaar in ruins is a painful reminder of Teldrassil’s precarious state and the corruption gnawing at the World Tree.
As a druid, the madness consuming the Gnarlpine furbolgs and the defilement of Starbreeze Village challenge the Cenarion Circle’s charge to restore balance to Teldrassil’s wildlife.
